extracted.intended_audience: students and contestants preparing for the USAMO / AoPS community
extracted.subtask_description: An AoPS Wiki index page that lists USAMO problems and solutions by year, intended as a reference/resource for students preparing for the USAMO and other math contests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verify AoPS wiki solutions
rubrics_metrics.description: AoPS wiki solutions are sometimes incorrect.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cross-check solutions against other sources (for example, John Scholes USAMO solutions are listed for pre-2000 contests) and do not assume every AoPS wiki solution is fully reliable.
